turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Dana from Darwix Health on a web session. I can help you check a health-insurance lead. Do you consent to continue and to let me use your answers for this qualification?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What kind of health insurance do you need?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What is your age in years?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Which city do you live in?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Who should be covered: just you, or family members as well?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The premium is too expensive for me.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: If the customer says the premium is too expensive, explain the monthly budget option and the co-pay choice, and do not promise a discount that is not on the rate card. Who should be covered: just you, or family members as well?
